segments.title:
Anthropic
goes public
segments.say: Anthropic, the company behind the AI assistant Claude, is now a public company. Here's what actually happened on day one.

segments.title: The IPO price
segments.say: Anthropic first marketed its shares at seventy to seventy-eight dollars. Demand pushed the final price to eighty-three dollars, above the range.

segments.title: The deal
segments.say: It sold 980 million shares. At eighty-three dollars, that's about 81 billion dollars raised, which Yahoo Finance calls a record. About 79 billion of that goes to Anthropic itself.

segments.title: Day one on Nasdaq
segments.sub: Thursday 19 Nov · vs the $83 IPO price
segments.source: Yahoo Finance, ANT daily bar, 19 Nov 2026
segments.say: On Thursday the stock opened at a hundred and eleven fifty, up 34 percent on the IPO price. It touched a hundred and fifteen, then slid to close at ninety-seven seventeen. Still up 17 percent.

segments.title: Bought at the open?
segments.source: Yahoo Finance, ANT daily bar, 19 Nov 2026
segments.say: Most people could only buy once trading began. Anyone who bought at the open was down almost 13 percent by the close. The eighty-three dollar price went mainly to the investors in the offering.

segments.title: The big picture
segments.source: Leverage Shares (citing Anthropic) · Yahoo Finance · Damodaran on the prospectus
segments.say: Six months ago, private investors valued Anthropic at 965 billion dollars. At the IPO price, Yahoo Finance puts it around one and a half trillion. And insider shares unlock in stages over the next six months.
